description: ESPHome device configuration, firmware, and IoT product development. Covers ESP32, ESP32-S3, ESP32-C3, ESP32-C6, ESP32-H2, ESP32-P4, ESP8266, RP2040, RP2350, nRF52, LibreTiny, Shelly, Sonoff, Tuya, BLE proxy, Matter firmware, Thread, Zigbee, GPIO, sensor YAML, LVGL displays, LED strips, voice assistant hardware, device flashing, Arduino conversion, alarm_control_panel, lock, valve, media_player, microphone, speaker, audio DAC, event entities, datetime entities, Z-Wave proxy, MIPI DSI displays, and DLMS smart meters. Also covers designing new ESPHome-based products: hardware selection, component sourcing, PCB design (KiCad), enclosures, 3D printing, CE/FCC certification, BOM optimization, and manufacturing from prototype to production scale.
